docs.text: Artifacts 1996 Commemorative Coin Health Elements will become more effective and restore a larger amount of Health . Minted for an occasion no one can quite remember. Amulet Increases Critical Chance for all Melee attacks by +5% . I don't know if this blessing can erase all my worries, but I'll take all the help I can get. Badge 11-60 Dylan takes significantly less damage from Environmental Hazards . The front of the badge says Fidelis Ad Mortem. Wonder what it means. Bar Blade Health regenerates slowly while a Summon is nearby. It's basically being held together by that rubber band but still works like a charm. Bout Guard Adds +50% Power recovery but Dylan takes +20% more damage. Wouldn't want to lose your teeth in a fight. Brass Dusters Combat Abilities deal +50% Damage but no Falter at all. You could do some real damage with these. Bug Spray Adds +30% Damage and Falter against Mold enemies. However, Dylan receives twice as much Infected build-up. Ordinary was always full of bugs in summer. The Oldest House sometimes got spiders. Catnip Toy Significantly reduces damage from falling into the void. The smell is strong, maybe it'll get strays to like me. Coffee Cup Health regenerates slowly outside of combat. I don't think I like coffee, but the researchers drank it all the time. Compact Critical Hits deal +50% more Damage . However, they deal 30% less Falter I used to watch my mom put her makeup on all the time, before she stopped going out. Energy Drink Adds +30% Critical Chance for all melee attacks when Dylan is at maximum Health . Dylan takes +20% more damage while this Artifact is equipped Darling let me have one of these to see if it affected my abilities. My hands were shaking for hours. Face Mask Gives Dylan resistance to Infected by increasing the time it takes for him to get the status effect. Wearing one can protect you and others from all types of airborne illness. Feeding Bottle Adds +30% Power recovery. This benefit is applied while affected by Infected or Burn Hopefully the parents had a backup bottle. Fingerboard Adds +25% Damage and Falter while using a Gravity Anomaly . Jesse and I got one of these from a cereal box once. Fork Increases Dylan's Sharp Damage output by 15% .
